messages:
Nora: FYI - saw ~80 leads fall into limbo (Awaiting Enrich) during morning batch; SLA breach on handoffs. brainstorming short-term fallback that preserves RR fairness.
Ibrahim: can we fanout assign to multiple SDR queues instead of single temp pool? spreads load and reduces owner churn.
Anya: fanout good but need idempotency and a primary owner to avoid duplicates in SF. maybe assign a 'primary_sdr' and also 'candidate_sdrs' list.
Sam: SDRs will hate candidates... keep it simple: primary owner = first assigned via RR, candidates only for internal routing, not visible in HS UI.
Priya: propose: 15s grace, then pick primary via RR with 3-way jitter (0-500ms) to avoid stampedes; set property 'fallback_mode=fanout-rr' and trace_id.
Nora: also circuit-breaker on enrich upstream: if enrich error rate >10% for 5m, widen to 45s and escalate.
Anya: SF sync rule: write owner only if sfdc_owner is null OR sync_force_owner=true; additionally store fallback_trace so we can reconcile.
LeadBot: synthetic event: contact.8712 enrichment=delayed -> assigned primary_sdr=queue-7 (sim)
Ibrahim: here's proto-config: 
```
FALLBACK_WINDOW_MS=15000
FANOUT_COUNT=3
JITTER_MS=500
RETRY_ATTEMPTS=1
CIRCUIT_BREAKER: error_pct=10, window_m=5
```
Priya: I'll build the webhook patch in staging (will include trace_id header and a metric: lead.fallback.fanout).
Sam: I'll prep a one-liner for SDRs and pin a note in the SDR channel. keep wording: 'primary owner assigned; candidates used for overflow only'
Anya: I'll add Datadog alert: fallback_fanout_rate > 1% for 10m, and a tile for 'primary assignment latency'.
Nora: test plan: Priya do 250 synthetic leads spike, Ibrahim measure duplicate-owner rate and SF churn, Sam validate SDR visibility.
Priya: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/1422 staging endpoint: https://staging.hub-webhook.redwood/fallback-fanout
Ibrahim: canary scheduled 09:00 PT tomorrow. will report metrics here.
Nora: target prod deploy Monday if canary green. action items summarized: Priya webhook patch, Anya SF sync guard + dashboards, Ibrahim canary+metrics, Sam SDR comms.
Sam: :thumbsup: will draft the SDR blurb and add a pinned FAQ.
Nora: thanks everyone. this should keep handoffs under SLA while we fix upstream enrich latency. :rocket:
